dict.string: After enabling PassBy, unlock once with your real passcode so it can learn it.
Turns every PassBy feature on or off.
Keeps your passcode (encrypted) so you don't have to enter it again after a respring.
Shows when the device was last unlocked above the passcode keypad.
Shows a small "PassBy: Trusted WiFi / Bluetooth" pill the first time you are auto-unlocked on a trusted network or device. Tap "Test toast" to preview it.
Used by the last unlock time and by magic passcode hour pairs.
Skips the passcode if the device was unlocked within the chosen timeout.
Skips the passcode while connected to the Wi-Fi networks you pick.
Skips the passcode while connected to the Bluetooth devices you pick. Devices are matched by MAC address, not by name.
Also works when the Wi-Fi or Bluetooth device connects while the phone is locked. Otherwise you must unlock once while connected.
Skips the passcode while headphones stay plugged in since the last lock. Designed for wired headphones; Bluetooth headphones may not count.
Skips the passcode when your paired Watch is nearby. ⚠️ It does not check whether the Watch itself is unlocked.
A second passcode that changes over time. It is built from 2-digit pairs, each taken from a source below. Typing it unlocks with your real passcode.
Must match your real passcode (4 or 6 digits).
Hour, minute, day, month, battery remaining, battery used, timeout, or fixed custom digits.
Remaining = current percentage (00 at 100%). Used = 100 minus the percentage (32 at 68%).

Accepts any digits and re-locks the phone after that time: first digit = minutes, second = tens of seconds (12 = 1 min 20 s). Auto-unlock stays off until the next real unlock. If several pairs are timeouts, only the last one counts.
Swaps the two digits of a pair (14 becomes 41).
Shifts the clock used by time and date pairs (+30 min at 9:41 gives 10:11). Also shifts the date around midnight.

A fixed passcode for friends. It unlocks normally, re-locks after the chosen minutes (0 = never) and keeps auto-unlock off until you unlock it yourself. ⚠️ Only numeric passcodes of 4 or 6 digits are supported, and the guest passcode must have the same length as your real passcode, otherwise it will not work. Only a hash of it is stored.
Turns off auto-unlock, magic and guest passcode after Emergency SOS is triggered (press the side button 5 times).
Turns off auto-unlock, magic and guest passcode between the chosen times.
Disables biometrics as well during that interval.
🙈 Also disable Face ID / Touch ID
Stays off after the interval ends, until you unlock with your passcode (or Face ID / Touch ID if allowed).
🔒 Keep disabled until next real unlock
Hides the alert shown when PassBy learns your passcode.
Restores every option to its default.
Emails the original developer (requires the Mail app).
